transcript.text: This is Swift, an automated flood assistant working with local emergency services. Am I speaking with someone at 1092 Cairnlomond Street?

Yes, this is 1092 Cairnlomond Street.  
We’re safe, three people here, no water inside.
Thank you for confirming your address and safety. How many people are at the home right now, including anyone who can't come to the phone?
Three people here. Everyone can come to the phone.

Thank you for letting us know everyone is reachable. Is there anyone there who can't leave on their own, for example someone who uses a wheelchair, needs oxygen, or is bedbound? If it's a wheelchair, does it have a motor?
No one can’t leave alone. No wheelchairs or medical needs here.
Got it, no one here can’t leave alone or has special needs. Is there water inside the home right now?
No water inside. Everyone’s safe here.
Thanks for checking in and sharing your update. If neighbors need a ride out, do you have a high-clearance truck, a boat, or free seats in a vehicle?
No truck, no boat, no free seats. Everyone’s safe here.
Understood, no truck, boat, or free seats reported. Let me read that back: 3 people; no water inside yet. Is that right?
Yes. Three people. No water inside.
Thank you for confirming your situation. I've recorded that everyone there can leave on their own. Don't drive through flooded roads. Turn around, don't drown. Goodbye.
